run_omnitact_demo: run the pybullet OmniTact sensor simulation demo with Hydra config
create_tacto_sensor: create a TACTO sensor instance using tacto.Sensor with omnitact config path
add_camera_to_sensor: add a camera to the OmniTact sensor using omnitact.add_camera with body id
add_body_to_sensor: add a body object to the OmniTact sensor using omnitact.add_body
render_sensor_output: render color and depth images from the OmniTact sensor using omnitact.render
